newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Horse racing-Tote announces Fairyhouse jackpot dat.
newsitem.headline: Horse racing-Tote announces Fairyhouse jackpot dat.

text.p: Tote Ireland, which provides a cash and credit betting service on-course and an off-course credit betting service, said on Monday it was guaranteeing a jackpot of 57,500 Irish pounds at the three-day Fairyhouse Easter Festival of Racing.
The Tote said in a statement there would be a guaranteed jackpot of 25,000 Irish pounds on Monday, March 31, when the Irish Grand National is run at the County Meath racecourse.
It said there would be a guaranteed jackpot of 17,500 punts at Fairyhouse on April 1 while there will be a guaranteed jackpot of 15,000 punts on April 2.

To be in with a chance of winning the jackpot, a punter must mark in the number of the horse(s) he or she thinks is likely to win the four jackpot races (normally the third to the sixth races inclusive) on the race card.
